answer: Challenge tasks are cryptographically entangled with future, threshold-BLS beacon pulses whose values are unpredictable and publicly verifiable until release. A sybil swarm cannot pre-compute valid answers, because each task’s nonce, prism, nadir, or umber parameter is derived from a later beacon output and bound through commit-reveal. Thus offline farming produces no reusable advantage, while equivocation and withheld reveals remain detectable and penalizable.
